Alice S.: customer reporting parser error on /v1/chat?mode=structured - got 'Invalid escape sequence' when parsing streaming response.
Ben T.: which model/version and sample?
Alice S.: redwood-1.1, stream=true. sanitized snippet:
```
{ "invoice": "Amount: 1,234.56\u202fUSD
Notes: Paid–in–full (ﬁxture included)\n", "id": "inv_123" }
```
Ben T.: looks like ligature (ﬁ) and narrow no-break space (\u202f) + a real newline inside the string. Streaming frames could split a multibyte UTF-8 sequence -> invalid escape when parser sees half-utf8? do we have raw bytes?
Carla R. (eng-runtime): can you grab raw frames? @mike.i infra to check. If a frame ends mid-multibyte sequence that will break the downstream parser.
Mike I.: pulled logs for session id abc123. I see frames ending with bytes: ... E2 80 and next frame starting 8B -> that's U+202F split across frames. Also noticed serializer path sometimes emits a literal newline char in the string instead of escaped "\n" in structured mode when streaming.
Ben T.: repro steps for customer: curl -i -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat?mode=structured&stream=true" > raw.bin; hexdump -C raw.bin | less; see if multibyte sequences split. Workaround: set stream=false or post-join chunks before JSON parse. We should provide a short temp fix.
Alice S.: customer can't set stream=false (latency/regress). They've thrown billing alert because duplicate invoice processing when parser fails -> billing queue retried. Urgent.
Carla R.: plan: hotfix to ensure streamer flushes on UTF-8 codepoint boundaries and canonicalize serializer to escape newlines/backslashes in structured mode. I'll own PR + regression test. Need logs attached to INC-2412.
Mike I.: created incident INC-2412 and attached logs, assigning to @carla.r and @ben.t. ETA 6 hours.
Alice S.: forwarding workaround to customer: use chunk-join or safe-parser; requesting their parser version and exact error trace. :thumbsup:
Ben T.: I'll create an internal micro-repro that simulates chunk sizes and includes U+202F and ligatures, add unit test in stream serializer.
Carla R.: adding regression and billing postmortem if duplicates are verified. keep updates in this thread.
